title: OBS PTZ DataVideo VISCA-over-TCP framing
problem: DataVideo PTC cameras accept a TCP connection but do not respond to raw VISCA packets because their TCP dialect prefixes every packet with its two-byte total length.
reproduce: Send the issue's 81 09 7e 7e 00 ff inquiry to a DataVideo camera as raw VISCA/TCP and observe repeated timeouts.
acceptance: DataVideo mode sends 00 08 81 09 7e 7e 00 ff, parses fragmented and coalesced length-prefixed replies, rejects invalid lengths, and leaves ordinary raw VISCA/TCP unchanged.
repair: Add a bounded DataVideo stream framer, route send and receive through it only when selected, and expose a separate DataVideo VISCA TCP camera choice with a persisted compatibility option.

verification.limitations: The test compiles and executes the production framing helper and checks the OBS wiring. It does not build the complete plugin or connect to a physical DataVideo camera.
verification.ownerCheck: In OBS, add DataVideo VISCA TCP, enter the PTC-150 address and port, and verify pan/tilt, release-to-stop, zoom, one preset recall, state inquiries and reconnect after power cycling. Attach the OBS log and record camera model and firmware.
